messages:
sre-bot: :rotating_light: p99 and 5xx spike in prod starting ~10m ago. alerts -> paging oncall. dashboards: https://dash.redwood/prod/latency?range=15m. suspected deploy: commit d9f3b2a.
marc (oncall): saw it. patch deploy rolled out 09:12 UTC? i'm taking this. paging handoff incoming.
jane: i can repro 504s hitting /v1/generate in eu-west-1. quick curl: ```curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'``` response: HTTP/1.1 504 Gateway Timeout
vikram: thanks. canary nodes show p95 jump from 120ms -> 900ms, p99 > 2s. kvcache miss rate spiked. looks like kvcache invalidation happened during the deploy.
liam: gateway logs show upstream timeouts to runtime pool: `context deadline exceeded`. new image is `redwood/runtime:v2026-03-15-d9f3b2a`.
marc (oncall): impact report please — which customers/regions?
ops-runner: initial telemetry: 11% global 5xx, EU 18% (primarily small model endpoints and chat endpoints). a few paying customers reported errors via support.
kate (support): flagged 3 customers (acct-1123, acct-2234, acct-998) — they see increased errors and session failures. raising to CSMs.
jane: trying a quick probe: curl against runtime backend ip shows delayed responses and occasional 500s with stacktrace containing `kv_cache.go:87: nil pointer`.
vikram: hmm nil pointer in kv cache — new code path in kv eviction. pretty likely regression. recommend rollback to previous runtime image.
liam: +1 for rollback. we'll also open circuit breaker on heavy routes to reduce cascading.
marc (oncall): proceeding with rollback. running: ```kubectl set image deploy/runtime runtime=redwood/runtime:v2026-03-08-c7a1f0e --namespace=prod && kubectl rollout status deploy/runtime -n prod``` will update routing, expect 2–4 min to stabilize.
incident-bot: Rollback initiated by marc (oncall). Incident created: INC-3846 (link: https://jira.redwood/inc/INC-3846).
marc (oncall): toggled circuit-breaker for /v1/generate to open for low-priority traffic (burst routing rule). command: `rbctl circuits set /v1/generate --mode=open --reason="postdeploy timeout"`
jane: post-rollback probe: ```curl -i https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"ok"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'``` -> HTTP/1.1 200 OK (200ms) :tada:
ops-runner: cloud metrics show 5xx dropping from 18% -> 2% in eu after rollback. p95 back to ~130ms.
kate (support): updating customers: we'll send a brief status note that errors were caused by a deployment regression and that rollback is complete.
vikram: leaving a note — we should pin kvcache eviction tests and add a synthetic to catch nil pointers in nightlies.
liam: for followup: create a canary gating rule to fail dark traffic if kv miss ratio > 5% during deploy.
marc (oncall): handing off monitoring to vikram for root-cause and postmortem. i'll update incident channel and start doc.
vikram: taking incident lead for RCA. will add timeline and assign owners.
incident-bot: Incident INC-3846 status: MITIGATED (rollback + circuit open). severity: Sev2. postmortem assigned to vikram.
marc (oncall): leaving notes in #oncall-handoff — i'm off shift in 15. 
jane: quick log snippet to include in postmortem: ```kv_cache.go:87: panic: runtime error: invalid memory address or nil pointer dereference
goroutine 123 [running]:
main.(*KVCache).Get(0x0, 0xc0001d...)```
ops-runner: adding followup tasks: (1) revert kvcache change in PR 4578 (2) add regression test (3) extend canary window to 10m for kvcache touching deploys.
kate (support): will send customer follow-up template to CSMs and mark impacted accounts.
vikram: noted. creating postmortem draft and linking telemetry. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
marc (oncall): closing loop here — if anything flares up ping me directly. good job team.
